desc: 无盖压圈固定垃圾袋不滑落，桶身加高底、多场景通用
kw: 客厅厨房卫生间垃圾桶
name: 居家简约压圈无盖垃圾桶款

shots.intent: 搜索页一眼点击：无盖桶形、口部压圈与开孔提手一次读全，主体纯净无干扰。
首屏主张：用居中胶囊眉标加两色大标题把「多场景通用 + 压圈不滑袋」一秒讲清。
shots.textZone: centred eyebrow pill 「{callout_1}」 in #242A2C on a #2FB2CC pill at 12pt, two-tone headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with the first two characters in #2FB2CC and the rest in #242A2C at 44pt, subline 「{callout_2}」 in #242A2C at 16pt

shots.intent: 放大真实痛点：袋身下滑、袋口翻出桶沿，脏边外露又难提走。
shots.textZone: one top label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #242A2C at 30pt with a thin 1px underline

shots.intent: 机制解释：压圈把袋唇压在桶沿下，袋身不外露也不下滑。
shots.textZone: one thin-outline label 「{callout_3}」 in #242A2C at 12pt with a 1px leader line to the ring seam

shots.intent: 证明差异：同一袋同机位，压圈侧袋口干净、普通桶侧袋边外露。
shots.textZone: one small label per panel, 「{callout_4}」 on the left and 「{callout_3}」 on the right, both in #242A2C at 12pt, plus a headline 「{selling_point_2}」 at 28pt across the top

shots.intent: 解释提拿逻辑：一体成型的开孔提手与桶身斜度看清，换袋提拿不脏手。
shots.textZone: one thin-line label 「{callout_5}」 in #242A2C at 12pt with a 1px leader line to the handle opening

shots.intent: 以工艺细节支撑耐用主张：加高底座圈、桶身过渡与无毛刺边口真实可读。
shots.textZone: one thin-line label 「{callout_6}」 in #242A2C at 12pt with a 1px leader line to the raised foot

shots.intent: 扩场景：窄身锥度桶站进水槽与柜门之间的窄缝，厨房备餐随手丢。
证明多场景通用：同一只桶在卫浴干区墙面同样自然，消除单场景违和感。
去下单疑虑：胶囊标签规格表加尺寸引线，参数全部留占位不臆造。
shots.textZone: spec band with four chip labels 「{callout_8}」 in #242A2C on #DCEFF4 chips at 12pt, plus one side height leader line and one base width leader line both reading 「{callout_8}」 in #242A2C at 12pt

shots.intent: 让买家自选配色：同款同机位排开不同桶身与压圈配色组合，色值可核。
shots.textZone: one caption under each bucket reading 「{callout_2}」 in #242A2C at 12pt, plus one centred headline 「{selling_point_3}」 at 30pt

shots.intent: 收口转化：一句两色主张加一枚水青胶囊按钮，把多场景选购逻辑收住。
shots.textZone: centred eyebrow pill 「{callout_1}」 in #242A2C on #2FB2CC at 12pt, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with its first two characters in #2FB2CC at 36pt, CTA pill button with rendered copy 「{callout_5}」 in #FFFFFF on #2FB2CC with fully rounded corners in the lower third

style.backgroundSystem: one surface family per shot: seamless #FFFFFF studio field, cool milk info panel #F6F8F7, pale lime-plaster block #E9EDEC, or soft aqua tint #DCEFF4 as the only graphic block; never photographic scenery inside an infographic panel
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in #242A2C inside a 1px circle, plus solid #2FB2CC numerals for numbered rows; no emoji, no 3D badges, no shield or medal artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright cool key from the front-left with a broad soft fill, crisp but short contact shadow under the bucket foot, 5500-6000K, glossy mouth rim gets one clean specular line only, no warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, cool milk info panel #F6F8F7, deep charcoal text #242A2C and one aqua accent #2FB2CC (or {accent_color} when a brand hue is supplied) with #DCEFF4 as the only soft secondary tint; cool 5500-6000K studio lighting with a bright front-left key, broad soft fill and short crisp contact shadows under the bucket foot; one modern geometric sans-serif family for every rendered Chinese and Latin label, two-tone headlines with the first two characters in #2FB2CC, headline 28-48pt and label 10-14pt, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; background system of seamless #FFFFFF, cool milk panel #F6F8F7, pale lime-plaster block #E9EDEC and soft aqua tint #DCEFF4, one surface family per shot; layout system of a centred eyebrow pill above a two-tone headline, hairline rules broken by one small circle node, zig-zag alternating two-column rows led by solid aqua numerals, and a chip-label spec table with dimension leader lines; icon system of single-weight thin line icons in #242A2C inside 1px circles; product presentation stays floor-standing with a true contact shadow, the mouth ring and oval bag slot legible, and identical scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no lids, pedals, sensors or swing tops added to an open-top bucket
no source brand wordmark, membership badge or QR code
style.presentationRules: floor-standing bucket only, base always in true contact with its surface; the mouth ring and the oval bag slot under it must be legible in at least three shots; consistent slight-taper silhouette across the set; identical bucket scale when variants sit in one row
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale lime-plaster pedestal #E9EDEC and smooth cool porcelain floor #DDE3E2, bucket body rendered as matte injection-moulded plastic with a fine grain, never glossy vinyl
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered Chinese and Latin text; two-tone headlines where the first two characters sit in #2FB2CC and the rest in #242A2C; headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and supplied as placeholders
